summary: Iteration 4 — validated analyte disambiguation by source, matrix badges (DB & Records), tier-coloured performance note pill, and the new Compare tab. Backend: 7/7 new pytest passed (test_iter4.py) + 9 prior iter3 tests unchanged. GET /api/analytes returns 378 items, every entry has source in {Ricos, EFLM}, shared names are correctly suffixed ('Glucose (Ricos)' Serum TEa 6.96, 'Glucose (EFLM)' Plasma TEa 5.5, 'Potassium (Ricos)' & 'Potassium (EFLM)'), unique-only names stay unsuffixed (e.g. 'Glucose-6-phosphate-1-dehydrogenase (G6PDH)'), and all slugs are unique. POST /api/analytes/import with a Sodium row correctly produces 'Sodium (Imported)' alongside 'Sodium (Ricos)'; DELETE /api/analytes/custom restores count to 378. Records regression: sigma 4.19 for TEa 6.96 / CV 1.4 / Bias 1.1; GET/PUT/DELETE all 200. Frontend: Calculator select trigger shows exactly one analyte after selecting 'Potassium (Ricos)' (no concatenated duplicates); result-performance-note renders 'Excellent performance' with the emerald/blue tier pill classes at CV 1.0/Bias 0.5, and switches to amber 'Imprecision problem — improve CV' at CV 2.5/Bias 0.2. Database tab search 'glucose' shows both Ricos & EFLM rows with matrix badges (Serum vs Plasma) and source labels. Lab Records: 41 record-matrix-badge-* rendered. Compare tab defaults to 'Potassium · 2 instruments', auto-fills Roche Cobas c502 / Ortho Vitros XT, chart card renders, both compare-stats-a/b populate, exactly one 'Higher mean σ' badge (compare-best-b), Instrument B options exclude A, and selecting single-instrument 'Glucose' shows compare-single-instrument-hint and empties Instrument B.

minor.issue: Duplicate EFLM 'Sodium' rows in tea_extended.py (Erythrocytes 4.6 & Leukocytes 57.7) collide into two items both named 'Sodium (EFLM)' after disambiguate(); same for 'Sodium Bicarbonate' and 'Sodium Chloride' variants. Slugs stay unique so behaviour is correct, but the UI shows two rows with identical display names. Consider appending matrix (or de-duping by name+source+matrix) inside disambiguate().

Review request claimed DELETE /api/analytes/custom would restore an unsuffixed 'Sodium'; in practice Sodium remains suffixed because two EFLM Sodium rows already exist. Not a code bug per se but the acceptance criterion is data-dependent — test updated to match reality.

ui_bugs.issue: Missing space between analyte name and first middle-dot separator. Renders as 'Potassium (Ricos)· Serum · TEa 5.6%' (no space before the first '·'). Add a leading space or margin to the meta span.

action_items: Cosmetic: add leading space (or margin-left) before the '·' in the analyte option meta span in SigmaCalculator.jsx (line ~118).

Optional data-quality fix: in disambiguate() also disambiguate rows that share (name, source) but differ in matrix (Sodium, Sodium Bicarbonate, Sodium Chloride) — e.g. append matrix, or drop duplicate low-relevance EFLM Sodium rows.
critical_code_review_comments: InstrumentCompare useEffect on line 40-43 depends on `instruments` array; when analyte changes both instA and instB reset in the same tick — works but the eslint-disable hides a subtle risk if `instA` is stale. Consider computing initial pair directly from instruments in a useMemo.
InstrumentCompare's winner check uses strict equality on mean sigma; near-tied floats will pick the first-added higher; acceptable but could flag ties with 'Tied' badge.
biological_variation.disambiguate() collides identical-name same-source multi-matrix rows (see Sodium note above) into duplicate display names.
server.py still uses deprecated @app.on_event startup/shutdown (unchanged from prior iterations).
seed_data_creation: Created Sodium import CSV via POST /api/analytes/import and deleted via DELETE /api/analytes/custom in module teardown. Created & deleted one TEST_Reg4 record. DB confirmed at 378 after cleanup.
context_for_next_testing_agent: iter4 additions: analytes have 'source' field; disambiguate() adds ' (Source)' when a name exists in multiple sources. New Compare tab at data-testid tab-panel-compare; picker testids: compare-analyte-select, compare-instrument-a-select, compare-instrument-b-select; hint: compare-single-instrument-hint; chart: compare-chart-card; stats: compare-stats-a / -b; winner: compare-best-a / -b. Matrix badge testids: bv-matrix-badge-<slug>, record-matrix-badge-<id>. Performance-note badge: result-performance-note (colour follows tier badge for good sigma; amber for QGI diagnosis). Sodium EFLM duplicate names by design (see minor issue).
rca of the issue: Only cosmetic finding — the calculator's analyte option renders name followed by `· Matrix · TEa X%` in a sibling <span> without a leading space, producing 'Name (Source)· Matrix …'. Fix: prepend a space in the child text span (line ~118 of SigmaCalculator.jsx) e.g. ` · {a.matrix} · TEa {a.tea}%` or add ml-1.
